item: Monte Carlo SE rule for bootstrap intervals implemented only for Shapley contributions
reason: Protocol: if the batch-means MCSE of any primary-figure CI endpoint exceeds 0.1 pp, B rises to 10,000. The code computed batch MCSE only for the Shapley contributions (maximum 0.045 pp); other bootstrap intervals used 4,000 replicates without the check.

item: Tango interval not computed for the PCE 7.5% crossing contrast (S11); helper variance error
reason: The contrast has 15 discordant pairs (12 vs 3), below the protocol threshold of 20, but the code requested Tango intervals only for Delta_U. The tango() helper also used n(2q - d(1+d)) instead of n(2q + d(1-d)); corrected and the interval computed post hoc (0.3 to 3.2 pp). The CR1 interval (0.1 to 3.1 pp) is wider and governs wording, which is unchanged.

item: S12 simulation SDs fixed at full-sample values across bootstrap replicates; no CI for the S12(A) UACR ratio
reason: Protocol: everything depending on sample-estimated quantities is recomputed in each replicate. The simulation error SDs were estimated once from the full sample (bootstrap varies people, not SDs), so S12 intervals understate uncertainty; the bootstrap CI for the UACR-model S12(A) ratio was not computed.

item: Coding error in the bootstrap interval for systematic visit effects (S9); corrected
reason: Each replicate subtracted the replicate-weighted theta with shifts removed from the fixed full-sample theta instead of the replicate-weighted theta, so the interval (-2.5 to 2.4 pp) was that of a single proportion. Corrected per the freeze rules for coding errors in a new versioned directory: -0.9 to 1.1 pp (paired bootstrap; CR1 Wald -0.9 to 1.1 pp). The point estimate (+0.13 pp) and interpretation are unchanged; the original output is retained.
